transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, call people back. Now I’ve stopped doing all that. Some days I sit in my little rental for hours, knowing I have things to do, but I just can’t make myself start.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Since I moved into the smaller rental after the divorce—about a year and two months now. That’s when things really started coming apart.
Before this past year, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt this down or lost interest in things?
I’m not sure. Nothing stands out to me like this before.
Have you ever experienced times when you felt the opposite—unusually high, wired, or full of energy, needing very little sleep?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that. I’ve mostly just felt slowed down and stuck.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling sad or down for most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure how to judge that. I’ve felt off for a while, but I couldn’t say it’s been sadness most of every day.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in almost all the activities you normally enjoy?
Yeah. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, call people back. Now I just… don’t do any of it. I’ll sit in my rental for hours knowing I should get moving, but I can’t make myself start.
How has your sleep been lately?
I’m not sure. It hasn’t stood out to me as one particular problem.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight lately?
I haven’t really noticed a major change in my appetite or my weight.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed being unusually tired every day, exactly.
Have you been struggling with strong feelings of worthlessness or blaming yourself excessively?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed feeling especially worthless or blaming myself a lot.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing your thoughts, or making everyday decisions?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed any real trouble with that. I can usually focus well enough and make my day-to-day decisions.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to end your life or wishing you weren't alive?
No, I haven’t had thoughts like that.
